subject: Entangler-XL variant: interop exception and staging pin proposal
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena@entangler.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Entangler-XL variant: interop exception and staging pin proposal

Team —

Following the integration smoke tests with Entangler-XL (variant: entangler-xl-v2), we observed a reproducible tokenization divergence between our hosted pipeline and the private VPC runtime when the input includes long-form code blocks and embedded JSON snippets. The mismatch shows up as subtle truncation and off-by-one tokens that cause downstream safety filters to false-positive and some prompt completions to degrade.

Quick summary:
- Repro steps documented in attached diff and metrics.
- Failure rate: ~1.8% of sampled prompts (see entangler-compat-metrics.csv).
- Affected flows: streaming completions with prefix caching enabled and when sequence length > 2,048.

Ask: I want to request a temporary staging pin (lock entangler-xl-v2) for the next two weeks while infra and model teams land a tokenizer alignment patch. Rationale: avoid a canary rollout into production that could trigger customer regressions and noise for quality monitoring.

What I need from each of you:
- Laura (Product): sign-off on the two-week provisional pin and communication text for affected customers.
- Karthik (Infra/Runtime): quick feasibility assessment for applying the tokenizer shim on the VPC side or a runtime token normalization layer; estimate and rollback plan.
- Marissa (Ops): gating/telemetry flags we should flip to continue limited internal testing without affecting existing routing.

Attachments: entangler-tokenizer-diff.patch (patch), entangler-compat-metrics.csv (summary), entangler-eval-notes.pdf (manual test notes).

Thanks — will loop in Elena from Entangler if we need a vendor patch.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Product Manager, Model Onboarding
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 11:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Entangler-XL variant: interop exception and staging pin proposal

Thanks Priyom — good catch. I skimmed the CSV and the failure clusters are small but concentrated on a couple of customer-facing intents.

I support a provisional two-week pin for staging, provided we include:
- A short customer-facing note (1 paragraph) explaining the temporary hold and that we are addressing model parity issues (no SLA impact statement).
- A triage runbook for CS to follow if customers report degraded completions.

Can you draft the customer text? Also add an explicit list of which customer routes would be excluded from any automatic routing to entangler-xl-v2 during the pin.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Product — Serving APIs
Redwood Inference

Laura — draft below for the customer note; happy to shorten. Also included the initial list of excluded routes (internal route ids).

Customer note (draft):
"We are temporarily pausing the rollout of Entangler-XL (entangler-xl-v2) for a small set of traffic patterns while we address a model tokenization mismatch that can affect a limited number of long-form completions. This pause is precautionary and will not impact access to other models or features. We expect a resolution within approximately two weeks and will update you once the rollout resumes."

Excluded routes (initial): rts-api-accounts, rts-streaming-code, rts-embed-json.

Laura — is this acceptable? Marissa/Karthik: I uploaded the trimmed metrics and patch to the Drive link.

Attachments: entangler-compat-metrics.csv

— Priyom

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Elena Park <elena@entangler.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 May 2028 13:21:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Entangler-XL variant: interop exception and staging pin proposal

Thanks Priyom — dug into the patch and test harness this morning. Quick notes:

- Root cause: tokenizer mapping for multi-byte delimiter sequences is inconsistent between the vendor tokenizer (used in the model artifact for entangler-xl-v2) and our internal tokenstream normalization during KV-cache serialization. This only surfaces when prefix caching + streaming are combined with >2k sequences.
- Short-term mitigation: we can implement a runtime token-normalization shim that normalizes the vendor token IDs to our serialization scheme at ingestion/outbound. Estimated effort: 2 engineer-days to code + 1 day for infra testing and canary. It would be deployable to staging only.
- Risk/rollback: the shim is purely translational; rollback is a config flip. No model artifact changes required.
- Action: If we pin staging, I recommend we also enable an opt-in internal routing flag for 48 hours to validate the shim under traffic and confirm metric stabilization.

I'll queue a small PR and a canary playbook. Priyom/Laura — if you approve, we start tomorrow morning and I can have the shim in staging by EOD Tuesday.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

- For the 48h internal opt-in, I'll create a feature flag (ff-entangler-shim-internal) and pre-populate it with our test tenants. We should keep telemetry sampling to 5% initially and ramp once metrics look stable.
- Please include the exact metric names to watch (per-token drop rate, completion-truncation-rate, safety-filter-false-positive).

Priyom: please finalize the customer text and confirm the list of excluded routes; Karthik: please post the PR link and expected canary timeline here when you have it. I'll sync with CS on the communications.

Thanks — Marissa
